Name: Farm To-Do List
Author: gaegoolinae
Description:
[b]Choose your language[/b]
The main download includes all 13 languages and follows your game language. For instructions and screenshots in your language, choose a link below.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55944]한국어[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55946]日本語[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55947]简体中文[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55948]Deutsch[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55949]Français[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55951]Español[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55952]Magyar[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55953]Italiano[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55954]Português do Brasil[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55955]Русский[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55956]Türkçe[/url]  ·  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55957]ภาษาไทย[/url]

[size=5][b]What’s ready this morning?[/b][/size]
Open the tab on the left before you head out. If the cheese is ready, a duck still needs a pet, or a request is due today, you’ll see it there. Click the long arrow to tuck the notebook away again.

[b]Plan your harvest[/b]
The green gold total beside your crops is an estimate for everything you have planted. Click the row to see harvest dates, then pick a date to see which crops will be ready together.

[b]Choose what matters today[/b]
• Taking a gift into town? Open [b]+ Add task[/b] and pick your villagers. Blue means selected. Their reminders carry over, and the notebook shows when you’ve finished the week.
• On your way to the Community Center? Pick several ingredients from a bundle. Donated items leave your list as you hand them in.
• Heading underground? Pick the Mines or Skull Cavern and set a target floor. For a fishing trip, choose a fish and quantity or set a gold target.
• Saving for a coop? Pick a building to compare Robin’s price and materials with what you already have.

[b]Make it yours[/b]
Use the bottom option to type a reminder of your own. Use the little × next to a note to remove it. The journal keeps quests and special orders together, with today’s deadlines in red.

[b]Installation[/b]
Install SMAPI, unzip the download, and place the DailyFarmNotes folder inside Stardew Valley/Mods. Start the game through SMAPI and load your farm. The notebook follows your game language.
